title: Door → Cross → Plane → Spiral Lifecycle
purpose: Unify threshold, crossing, present-state, incorporation, recurrence and return into one canonical process so Door, Cross, Plane, Here/Now, Spiral, Fruit and Seed are not treated as disconnected symbols.

lifecycle.meaning: stable or at least identifiable prior state/context
boundary becomes relevant; permissions, evidence, consent, capability or conditions are tested
old attachments/status/assumptions are loosened or distinguished
between-state where old and new contexts overlap and the outcome is not yet incorporated
trajectory intersects the active Plane and/or satisfies the Door guard
current state is gathered at the operative present; past provenance and future options are distinguished
new state becomes socially, technically, bodily or narratively real
record the resulting current frame/state for later comparison
trajectory later crosses a comparable section/frame
compare governing state: unchanged recurrence = Ring; meaningful changed recurrence = Spiral
evaluate downstream consequence/capability rather than celebrating crossing itself
compress viable future pattern/capacity from the changed present
upper/integrated material returns to World/body/context and begins another cycle

strong_transition_requirements: reversibility, appeal or exit stated when meaningful
later return crossing compared if Spiral/Ring language is used
distinctions: Crossing a Plane does not automatically mean passing a strong Door.
Door can exist without immediate crossing.
O/Here is the present-state gathering point, not the whole Plane.
Incorporation is separate from crossing; an unrecognized new state may remain liminal.
Spiral is diagnosed from comparable returns, not from one crossing.
Fruit judges downstream consequence; Seed carries future capacity.
Return is part of the lifecycle; ascent without return is incomplete in project grammar.

failure_modes.meaning: apparent passage returns to same or worse governing regime
transition never resolves and dependency on the threshold becomes the new state
event occurs but rights/status/context never update
repetition is celebrated as development without measurable state change
state changes but downstream consequence produces no durable capability/repair/generativity
future pattern is asserted without present conditions capable of supporting it
